question: with the SC-SFK addressing live in the real store, does the same 154-question battery reproduce the runner-side reading, and is anything lost in the move?

conflict_batch.route: table-level batch API: two items with equal feature sets and different values

idempotent_probe.document_frequency_note: repeating a record counts as a second observation and raises its word's df; the probe therefore restores the snapshot before the readings are used

cost.write_cpu_resolution_note: 30 accepted writes stay below the 15.6 ms Windows process-time tick, so the per-write figure is measured on the high-resolution wall clock

scope.note: the write stores the current fast snapshot; a matched read blends it into fast with alpha = 0.5; no_match and ambiguous leave fast bit-identical

disclosures: the store value is the fast snapshot, so re-observing the same record with a moved fast state is a replace (the displaced snapshot is kept in the address history), not a merge.  The 8 base observations therefore show replaced = 7 and merged = 0; the observation count, the carrier frequency and the address are unchanged by that.

the conflicting batch is exercised through the table batch API: two items with equal feature sets and different values, which the per-record wired path cannot form in one call.  Rejection is whole-batch and the table is compared before/after.
a read that returns no_match or ambiguous returns the same state object; the value path is exercised only by the matched class and is reported separately.
closed-state parity is reported by the closed phase; this phase only records that the flag is on.

plain_language.what_this_proves: the address really was a missing part of the algorithm: with the flag on, the same record battery that the dense mean-key store could not tie (8/22 paraphrases, 14/66 unwritten) now resolves through one structural rule, and switching the flag off changes not one bit of the old forward.
plain_language.what_this_does_not_prove: nothing here shows the address can be shaped by training; the primitive is closed-form statistics with zero parameters, so no gradient reaches it.
plain_language.what_this_still_depends_on: every record in this fixture carries its own rare word, which is exactly what the unique-anchor rule needs. That is a property of the fixture, not a general conclusion about natural text.

criteria.C1_default_off: LivingCoreConfig() reports sc_sfk_enabled is False and no code path other than the single flag branch at the entry of attach_store/clear_store/addressed_read/addressed_write can be taken; there is no half-open branch mixing the two paths.
criteria.C2_closed_bit_identical: with the flag off, the returned fast bytes and the post-read probabilities of all 176 readings, the store signature, the parameter table digest, state_bytes and candidate_sha_v2 are identical to the pre-change baseline: max|delta| = 0 exactly.
criteria.C3_zero_new_parameters: parameter tensor count, parameter element count and the full state_dict digest are unchanged; the address table is pure Python and holds no tensor.
criteria.C4_open_self_read: after the wired write path, each of the 22 written faces resolves, read back from its own store key (the raw bytes), to the address it was written at.
criteria.C5_open_reproduces_runner_side: paraphrase >= 20/22 AND unwritten >= 60/66 AND new_token no_match >= 20/22 AND no_value ambiguous >= 20/22
criteria.C6_open_write_side: growth starts at 2, expands at least three times, reaches >= 16; 23 distinct addresses; evictions = 0, silent overwrites = 0, rollbacks = 0; the conflicting two-item batch (equal feature set, different values) is rejected whole and the table is unchanged afterwards.
criteria.C7_open_value_path: a matched read blends the stored fast snapshot into fast (moved_on_matched > 0), a no_match or ambiguous read returns the same state object (moved_on_abstain = 0), and the value read back from each of the 22 written addresses hashes to the fast snapshot taken at write time (22/22).
criteria.V_wire_not_neutral: any closed-state bit, parameter, state-bytes, identity or store-signature difference: hard failure, report store_addressing_wire_not_neutral and stop.
criteria.V_wired: closed passes and C4/C5/C6 hold: store_addressing_wired.
criteria.V_wired_regression: closed passes but at least one measurable open-state class is below its threshold or a write-side counter degrades: store_addressing_wired_regression with the degraded facet and its cause listed per class. The words 'basically the same' are not a verdict.
criteria.V_inconclusive: closed passes but the open-state reading cannot be compared (missing runner-side reference or an empty class): inconclusive, distribution only.
criteria.unchanged: no fixture, class, span, position or threshold is retuned after the first reading
